asked.item: Why it posted at 4:00 am instead of 9:00

verdict.reason: The help pages state that a timestamp without an offset is treated as UTC, which explains the time shift, and they say how to send an explicit offset or Z.

steps.text: A scheduledTime with no timezone offset is treated as UTC.
Your scheduledTime of 2026-12-01T09:00:00 had no offset, so it was read as 09:00 UTC, not 9:00 in your timezone.
For API schedules, send scheduledTime as ISO-8601 with an explicit offset or Z, resolved for the date and your timezone.
